scope: Visual review of listed exact previews and source sheets, in addition to inline bear generation sheets. No claim of in-app continuous playback or interpolation. Earlier preview raster revisions are not retroactively marked alignment-passed.

observations.bear-small: All22 keys in dark contact show consistent ivory bear identity, no hat or red cheeks, no missing or extra limbs. Pond direction and tail side follow viewpoint. Crouch and seated keys retain head scale.
observations.hamster: All16 keys retain one continuous body with no limbs, no added tail/nose/whiskers, simple eyes and mouth. Ear-fold signature reads clearly.
observations.cat-patches: All16 contact keys retain screen-left orange/screen-right brown head patches in frontal projection and tail on screen right; no siamese conversion, extra limbs or clipped tail.
observations.bear-beret: New success_air and corrected seated signature appear clean at actual1008x567 preview; red beret over one eye is intentionally occluding, not an absent eye. Existing neutral is retained.

limits: Static/discrete pose assessment only. Technical registration and final alignment use the separately versioned current diagnostics.
Producer and independent reviews cover native light/dark and larger single-frame previews.
